messages:
maya: Quick follow-up thread from the postmortem  we had about the memory/KV-frag OOMs. Goal: concrete owners, short timelines, and a testing+rollout checklist. Can we finalize here?

raj: I can own profiling and artifact collection. Plan: nightly jemalloc dumps + pprof on 10m windows for canaries and a neighboring prod slice. Will upload diffs. ETA initial report: 2026-03-31.

olivia: I'll take metrics and alerting. Adding job-level tags and a fragmentation dashboard. Will add alerts for sustained fragmentation and OOM-rate thresholds. PR coming today, ETA 2026-03-27.

simon: I'll prototype two GC configs: (A) jemalloc background_thread=1, (B) arena-shrink aggressive. Small harness to measure fragmentation and 95p latency with the standard load profile. Results by 2026-03-26.

lee: I'll coordinate the rollout across Dedicated pools and Dedicated canaries. Plan: implement soft memory caps, enable new kernel vm.dirty_ratio settings, and then staged canary rollout. Draft runbook by 2026-04-04.

maya: Good. Let's capture explicit action items so they're actionable: raj: profiling+dumps (2026-03-31); olivia: dashboards+alerts (2026-03-27); simon: GC tests (2026-03-26); lee: rollout runbook (2026-04-04). Weekly check-ins until closed.

maya: Observations from postmortem to keep in mind: fragmentation spikes align with long-running KV-scan jobs and with model variants that have long seq lengths. We should tag traces with seq_len and job_type.

raj: I'll include tags: seq_len_bucket, job_type (kv-scan|inference), model_variant. Also adding per-job RSS snapshots before/after large scans.

olivia: For alerts I'm proposing: P1 if cluster-wide OOMs > 2 in 1h; P2 if fragmentation > 60% for 10m on any host; P3 if single-host resident memory growth > 20% in 30m. Thoughts?

simon: Add perf guard: any GC change must pass the 10k-req sustained load test with <3% 99th latency regression. We should also baseline token p50/95/99 before changes.

ci-ops-bot: canary deploy started for runtime/dedicated-canary-7 at 2026-03-22T08:03:17Z :rocket:

raj: Early dump sample from a canary (sanitized):
```
jemalloc stats snapshot 2026-03-22T08:45:02Z
allocated: 3.2GiB
resident: 4.6GiB
internal fragmentation: 39%
top arenas: a12=1.0GiB, a5=1.1GiB
```
I'll attach full diffs to the GH issue.

olivia: I'll add a metric that exposes per-job fragmentation delta so we can tell if KV-scan releases memory or leaves holes. Also wiring alerts into #incidents and the new issue.

lee: Rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with a 3h hold at each stage. Abort/rollback if P1 fires or if we see >2% 95p latency regression.

maya: Raj, when you upload artifacts include: heap histo top 20 alloc sites, jemalloc fragmentation ratio, per-arena breakdown, and pprof flamegraphs. Olivia, link dashboards in the issue.

raj: Will do. Creating GH issue now and will add checkboxes for each artifact. Adding repro steps.

olivia: I've created the dashboard PR and added the new frag metrics. Alert rules drafted: reviewers @maya,@lee.

simon: Quick note from initial test matrix: background_thread=1 reduced fragmentation by ~7% in the harness but raised 95p by 1.6%. Full matrix to be uploaded tomorrow.

lee: If simon's flags cause latency >2% we'll keep them out of 10% stage. We can also try switching specific arenas to be less sticky as a narrower change.

maya: Also want to track recurring pattern: spikes around 00:00-04:00 UTC. Can we add a weekly cron to run a deeper jemalloc trace during that window?

raj: I'll schedule targeted traces during that window on next canary runs and correlate with KV-scan schedules.

ci-ops-bot: scheduled job `jemalloc-nighttrace` for dedicated-canary-7 run id cjd-20260323-02

maya: OK. Please update the GH issue when you finish each action. I'll set a weekly 09:30 UTC triage standup until everything is closed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(END)
